dialogue.text: Good morning, private banking, Claire Tan speaking. How may I help you?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Good morning, Claire Tan. This is Adrian Lee. I'm calling about my existing investment account. I'm at the office, but I have a quiet room available. I would prefer to deal with the conversation by telephone rather than start another lengthy email exchange.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can keep the conversation focused. Telephone contact is noted as your preference, although any documents that need to be sent will still come through the usual channel. We can begin with your identification and the holding you wish to discuss.

dialogue.text: My FIN is F seven seven seven seven zero double two R. My date of birth is the twenty-ninth of November nineteen fifty-four. The holding I want to transact in is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian Lee. I recommend selling Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'll keep that in mind. On the contact arrangements, a call is usually easier while I'm at the business. Emails tend to get buried among supplier correspondence. I do read the formal documents, but a long chain of replies can become difficult to follow.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: For routine contact, is it better to call your existing number and leave a message if you're occupied, rather than try to catch you through the office?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, use my existing number. Please keep any voicemail brief, and I'll return the call when I'm free. I've also been spending more time away from my desk recently. I've taken up gardening, which is rather different from dealing with suppliers all day.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a welcome change of pace. Have you been working on an established garden, or starting something new?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Mostly tidying an established garden and learning what belongs where. I had expected to enjoy choosing plants, but I find the ordinary maintenance quite absorbing. It is pleasant to finish something without having another email arrive immediately afterwards. Anyway, let me return to the account.

dialogue.text: I'll end the call here, Adrian Lee. Any further administrative contact can be through your existing number, with a brief message if you're unavailable.
